notes: Stories refined for stricter contract clarity and frontend-only scope alignment.

change_log.value: Clarified contract includes strict typing and markdown-safe embedding constraints
change_log.note: Prevent schema drift and rendering conflicts

change_log.value: Added explicit accessibility and layout non-regression requirements
Clarified responsibility as validation of payload consistency, not backend implementation

stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and enforce a strict frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat payloads, ensuring markdown-safe rendering compatibility and preventing schema drift.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side logic to normalize and format backend distance values (rounding, unit consistency, '<1 mi' handling, null safety) into a display-ready string aligned with the defined contract.

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble to display formatted distance inline with provider results (near name/address) while preserving markdown rendering, layout integrity, responsiveness, and accessibility (ARIA labels, screen reader clarity, no layout regression).

stories.title: Distance Payload Integration Validation
stories.description: Validate that distance fields from backend (MAINT-DIST via find_care_facade and tool_router) arrive in chat responses and conform exactly to the frontend contract, with no transformation gaps or missing fields at render time.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance contract compliance, formatting logic, rendering behavior in MessageBubble, and edge cases (missing, null, malformed values, extreme distances).
